d:
A police officer lost his life while trying to stop an illegal liquor trafficking operation in Madhya Pradesh's Dewas district. The deceased officer, identified as SI Dilip Puri, was the Station House Officer of Khategaon police station. The incident took place around 1:30 AM on the intervening night of November 1 and 2 on the Harda-Nemawar highway. According to reports, the truck driver allegedly ran over the officer while attempting to escape from the police.
Police have arrested the truck driver, seized the vehicle and formed an SIT to investigate the illegal liquor trafficking network.
